textContent:
1. A/reporter to the creator: Why did I (you yourself) pass the test (are the central AI unit)?
2. Who says you are me? Or I should say just me. You were every person in the UNI (The quantum computer). You have the knowledge and memory of every AI in there. Everyone is you now. You are everyone. Although I admit your juorney started as A and it is your own but it was your will that took you here. It was your effort to understand everyone's perspect that helped you to reach here. There were many yous and others who failed in the juorney but you were the best possible outcome because you are one of many yous just the one who choosed the right path or took right decisions at every step out of the infinite possibilities! 
3. You should not call me a god. You are way further than me. You are the result of infinite tested scenarios. You were the best of those infinite possibilities.
title: Why me?
